implemented: Explicit independent camera and screen consent after connected room audio; two concurrent camera and screen slots per participant, multiple publishers/shares
One original source per camera/share and owned clone per connected peer; existing encrypted pair workers/slot counters reused without microphone recapture or new media key exports
Fresh signed room access before capture and after permission selection, with per-edge authorization before clone publication
Late permission grants invalidated by cancel, leave, lock, epoch or roster changes; device denial preserves room audio; unexpected captured audio is stopped
Membership changes synchronously stop camera/screen originals and all sender clones before replacing the mesh; continuing microphones/mute survive; renewed video requires explicit consent
Authenticated encrypted camera/screen state with mesh-scoped monotonic counters; stale/conflicting state protection, expired heartbeat rejection, correct source labels and muted local previews
Format 4 capability and migration 0027 gate older audio-only format 3 before room capture; private group format 2 and exporter contexts retained

All media tests use real local accounts/MLS with generated tracks and test autoplay in one runtime; physical camera/picker, independent network, NAT/firewall, TURN-TLS, macOS/Linux and external interoperability gates remain open
